Hello from the Companion Animal Travel Desk.

Staff must follow the established process flow for every companion animal booking handled by Aurelia Skyways. Record service changes immediately in the desk ledger, and verify traveler details before any handoff begins. If Layla Williams or Andre Ibrahim arrives early, do not start paperwork out of sequence; keep the workflow clean and consistent.

The boarding steps must be completed within 68 hours, meaning passengers meet the deadline for travel processing. The check-in step uses form FM-286, meaning it is the required document that must be submitted. The transfer phase is overseen by the Records Curator, meaning a specific staff role supervises the process end-to-end.

If Ellie is involved, confirm the animal identifiers against the ledger entry and ensure the traveler receives the correct next instructions. Escalate any discrepancies to supervision right away; delays create operational risk.

Training Editor, Companion Animal Travel Desk
